title: Core Optimizations
body:
This modpack is focused in **solely** in optimization. **Any other mods that arent for optimization were used for testing.**


Core Optimizations uses **Vulkan**, making it incompatible with shaders and other rendering mods since it uses its own rendering engine, not **OpenGL**.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

List of mods:

- VulkanMod
- C2ME (Concurrent Chunk Management Engine)
- Fzzy Config 
- More Culling
- Lithium
- Entity Culling
- Particle Core
- VulkanBobby
- Fast Noise
- Dynamic FPS
- Mod Menu
- Smooth Boot
- Bobby
- Cloth Config API
- Chunky
- ModernFix
- Alternate Current
- BadOptimizations
- FerriteCore
- FastQuit
- Performance Overlay
- Krypton
- ScalableLux
- Fabric Lenguage Kotlin
- SmartBlockPlacement

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Recommendations:

Allocate atleast **8gb** ram for best performance

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

This modpack is **incompatible** with any other rendering mod or shaders. 
Any other resource pack/mod that isnt for optimization was used for testing.
